title: Beyond Twenty Questions: Semantic Limits and Query Complexity of Universal Concept Identification
domain: information theory / active learning / lexical semantics / ontology / philosophy of language / computational cognition
summary: A formal and empirical research program measuring the query cost imposed by semantic admissibility across heterogeneous concept regimes, with source-locked lexical calibration and a three-protocol human design (P2 binary, P3 coarse MAYBE, P6 fine-grained semantic states) that isolates whether semantic state distinctions add value beyond a generic non-binary escape response.
